parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Sheena wants to write a function to return the number of boxes of eggs that she needs to
buy. The function takes, as a parameter, the number of eggs required for a recipe. There are
6 eggs in a box. Sheena needs to buy enough eggs, but does not want any full boxes of
eggs left over.
She knows that she can use the operators DIV and MOD to calculate the required number of
boxes.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Show the results for the following expressions:
20 DIV 6 =
20 MOD 6 =

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Complete the pseudocode:
FUNCTION CalculateNumberOfBoxes(NumberOfEggs : )
RETURNS
DECLARE : INTEGER
NumberOfBoxes  // how many full boxes?
IF NumberOfEggs MOD // need part of a box?
THEN // increment number of boxes
ENDIF
RETURN NumberOfBoxes
ENDFUNCTION
